notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png

 Season 3 will begin November 21, 2023!


 The New Season Passes have been added and the Shop, and the overall Shop lineup has been redesigned.


 The number of equipment Glamours for each class available with the Premium Season Pass has been increased from Season 2.

 The price of the Premium Season Pass has been changed from 1820 Goldings to 2050 Goldings.

 Each menu screen and Title logo will be revamped for Season 3.


 The top header and general menu background have been changed to a blue background, and the pattern has been updated.

 Changed the background model of the top menu.

 Changed the game logo on the title screen.

 New ★5 Cleric Title: Harvest Queen.


 New Ult Skill, Harvest Dance: Spray fruit around yourself to strengthen nearby allies. Sometimes rare glowing fruit will also appear. These sport increased effect.


 Apples: Boosts attack.

 Muscats：Boosts movement speed.

 Corn: Apply protection effect.

 New 2-Army Battle Map: Labyrinth Temple


 This underground labyrinth stage includes new elements such as movable siege weapons, pitfalls, and moving floors!

 Added new Tips to the loading screen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png

 All starting skills through level 4 are now accessible to new players. This is to make it easier for players to utilize high rank Titles as soon as they get them. 

 The restriction on purchasing skills on the Shop screen has been removed. Players can now purchase as many skills as they want as long as they have enough Silvings.

 Meteor Cataclysm adjusted.


 The area of effect when the Meteor Cataclysm is triggered has been adjusted so that it is more concentrated in a rectangular area in front of where it was invoked.

 The interval between invoking the Meteor Cataclysm and the meteors falling has been shortened. 

 Robot Cataclysm improved. 


 Increased the damage of melee attacks.

 The rapid fire gatling gun ranged weapon has had its damage and travel decay improved to give the Robot better ranged combat capabilities. 

 Adjusted the camera to make it easier to shoot when piloting the machine gun and cannon.

 The Cleric skill "Warp Gate" can no longer be activated on siege towers because the gate remains in the air even when the tower moves away. 

 Recovery after throwing an enemy has been reduced for the Warrior skill "Power Bomb" to make it easier to use in melee combat.

 The Magic Arrow magic shot has been adjusted.


 The Magic Arrow was generally superior in all aspects: range, fire rate, and damage, making it a versatile weapon that was not limited by any situation. In addition, its DPS is high compared to other weapons. With this update, we want to emphasize the rapid-fire aspect of the shot to maintain the usability of the weapon, while reducing the effective range and DPS to better outline the strengths and weaknesses of the weapon.

 Damage to enemies: 14->11

 Fire rate: 500->600

 Maximum range:100->85


 Bullet travel decay start distance: 50 -> 35

 The Fireball magic shot has been adjusted.


 The fire rate and bullet speed of Fireball has been adjusted to improve the accuracy of the weapon and the feeling of impact. All other parameters were also adjusted to match the improved fire rate. In addition, to better emphasize the importance of the immolation effect, hitstun has been eliminated but the increased rate of fire makes it easier to set opposing players on fire.

 Damage to enemies: 50⇒40

 Damage to objects: 50⇒40

 Fire rate: 75⇒100

 Immolation: 46⇒36

 Enemies will not enter hitstun when hit by fireball.

 Bullet speed and homing improved making it easier to strike enemies.

 Revolver cannon performance adjusted


 Fixed an issue where damage was sometimes not done even though it appeared to hit the enemy

 Increased bullet speed

 Damage to enemies: 35->40

 Damage to objects: 36->40

 The Revolver Cannon is a weapon that deals a certain amount of damage to both targets and opponents and can flinch opponents, but currently it is difficult to hit enemies with it and has relatively low DPS, leaving it as an underused weapon. Therefore, two adjustments have been made to improve the difficulty of hitting the target and to increase the amount of damage.

 The effect value of the attack power up buff has been adjusted because the current effect value is low, making it difficult to notice the effect.

 lv3: 1.075->1.15

 lv4: 1.1->1.2

 lv5: 1.125->1.25

 lv6: 1.15->1.3

 lv7: 1.175->1.35

 To provide a wider range of customization options and emphasize the effectiveness of temporary buffs, we have adjusted the amount and duration of the buff effects for currently under-utilized Mythic Perks.


 Effect degree

 Vengeant Speed 5s->7s

notes.title: 🌟 Addressing recent discussions in the Community 🌟
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

Thank you so much for all of the support you have shown to Warlander. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable to us, and we're committed to addressing these topics.

We hear your feedback, and agree that getting new players into the game is a priority. We believe that there are things that need to improve within the game to make sure that when new players join they have a good time, and play for longer.
New Player Experience
These past few weeks a lot of our focus has been set on the new player experience. Their first impression is important, so we've dedicated significant effort recently toward enhancing features such as the Tutorial and Matchmaking to ensure that new players aren't overwhelmed by more seasoned players.
Quality of Life (QoL) improvements
To address the feedback for QoL improvements within the game, we first want to clarify that the teams working on expanding the game's content and adding new Maps are distinct from the teams dedicated to adding QoL improvements such as UI and Balancing. Both are important and we're committed to enhancing the gameplay experience on all aspects.

Regarding the priority of these topics, we hear your feedback and we’re making adjustments internally to shift our efforts to QoL improvements.

Previously, a lot of our effort has been set on the Arena mode, to make sure it is a fun experience when it's released. Now that Arena Mode is nearing completion this team now has more time to focus on QoL improvements, such as Renaming Characters which was released recently.
Upcoming Features / Changes
We're actively developing some of the most requested features based on your feedback, and we're excited to provide you with updates on our progress.
CrossParty
CrossParty is a significant focus for us, We've taken your frustrations and feedback seriously. Implementing CrossParty functionality is a complex feature and we’re working tirelessly to get this to you as soon as possible. We're currently aiming for CrossParty to be implemented This Season.
Voice Chat
We've been working on finding the best way to make Voice Chat and Communication work within Warlander considering the team sizes. We're planning on releasing this together with CrossParty.
Known Issues we’re looking into
We have heard your frustrations of issues within the game recently, and are working to address these. Some notable Issues that we’re working on are:
•    [strike]Melee Combat/Collision[/strike] (Fixed on 11. Sep.)
•    [strike]Hymn of War[/strike] (Fixed on 15. Sep.)
•    Reserved Matchmaking Issues
•    Changing brightness bug
Q&A Answers
Thank you for all of the questions you guys have sent in during the Q&A and we apologize for the wait you’ve had to endure during this time.

These questions sparked a lot of conversations internally and provoked a change in our timeline and priorities to make this game the best it can be. Unfortunately this meant, many of the answers to your questions which were already in progress had become either obsolete all-together or required significant editing.

Therefore the Q&A answers will be run out in two parts, as we want to answer as many of your questions as possible, and as quickly as possible. The first part will come out later this season.

notes.title: 🌟 Replacing Sentry Anti-Cheat with Denuvo 🌟
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

Next Week, Warlander's Steam version will begin with testing the anti-cheat software "Denuvo" in the user environment.

The intention, if all goes to plan, is to replace Sentry entirely with Denuvo.

During the test, both Denuvo and Sentry will be running.

The Sentry launcher may be turned off, but this does not mean that Sentry is uninstalled.

After the test, if we make the final decision whether to implement Denuvo over Sentry or not, we will publish the procedure for uninstalling Sentry again.

Denuvo will need to be installed once it's been implemented.

The following is an FAQ regarding the introduction of Denuvo.

If you're having any issues during this trial period, don't hesitate to reach out to our player support:
https://to.plaion.com/WarlanderSupport


How does Denuvo work?

Denuvo, like other anti-cheat services monitors a player’s game and detects unauthorized use of third-party programs or modifications.

Does Denuvo affect game performance?

Denuvo anti-cheat solution does not interfere with the regular operation of the game and does not cause errors or reduce stability to system performance.

Do I need to install Denuvo?

Denuvo is installed with the user's permission the first time the Denuvo-supported Warlander is launched.

Can I uninstall Denuvo?

Yes, you can uninstall Denuvo with the standard Windows features.

However, if you launch Warlander after uninstalling Denuvo, you will be prompted to re-install it; playing Warlander will require Denuvo to be installed.

What is the Anti-Cheat SDK? / How does it work?

Anti-cheat SDK solution secures online gameplay mechanics that reward offline progress. 

It protects sensitive game logic and data, prevents cheaters from changing a sensitive variable, such as decrypting saved games or modifying network traffic, and also provides protection against the most common cheat tools.

Is anti-cheat software in kernel mode safe?

Running the driver component in kernel-mode can raise concerns, but kernel-level access is needed to detect cheaters effectively. 

It’s worth mentioning that the most popular multiplayer games have adopted kernel-mode anti-cheat for effective protection.

Read more here about kernel access and games that use this: 
https://blog.irdeto.com/video-gaming/denuvo-anti-cheat-why-we-chose-to-use-a-windows-kernel-mode-driver-in-our-solution/

notes.title: 🌟 Season 2 Release Notes! 🌟
notes.content:
Release Notes

Greetings Warlander!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png


 With the start of Season 2, a new Season Pass with new Glamours and profile banners is here!

 A new Tier 5 Title for Warriors, Soul Eater, has been added.


 The Ult Skill Cursed Sword can kill an enemy with a single blow if the attack is made within 6 seconds of activation. if the enemy is killed within 6 seconds, the duration is reset.

 An overtime system has been implemented for the 2 Army and 5 Army Battle Modes.


 If a Battle ends with the remaining Core HP for 2 or more armies being identical, there will be 5 minutes of overtime.

 During overtime, Core will have 5% HP and all castle gates will be destroyed and cannot be rebuilt.
 Added feature to select armor type.


 Each armor type can be equipped with different equipment and Glamours.

 Each armor type has its own characteristics and slightly different basic performance.

 A Matchmaking Reservation system has been implemented to match more players at once.


 While using Matchmaking reservation, you can edit your character and customization options until you find a match.

 Matchmaking will be adjusted in real time as needed based on the number of active users and the Ranked Status of players at any given time.

 New Titles have been added.


 Warrior

 Tier 1 Challenger: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes
 Tier 2 Rebel: +5% Damage to Superior Foes
 Tier 3 Scoundrel: +24% Ladder Climbing Speed
 Tier 3 Bombardier: +22.5% Damage inflicted from Siege Weapons
 Tier 4 Dreadnought: +30% Damage inflicted from Siege Weapons
 Tier 4 Outlaw Hero: +32% Ladder Climbing Speed

 Cleric

 Tier 1 Indomitable: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes
 Tier 2 Recusant: +5% Damage to Superior Foes
 Tier 3 Mendicant: +150% Tower Capture Speed
 Tier 3 Inquisitor: +7.5% Damage to Mages
 Tier 4 Exorcist: +10% Damage to Mages
 Tier 4 Liberator: +200% Tower Capture Speed

 Mage

 Tier 1 Curmudgeon: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes 
 Tier 2 Insurgent: +5% Damage to Superior Foes 
 Tier 3 Deadeye: +11.25% Headshot Power
 Tier 3 Strategist: +150% Tower Capture Speed
 Tier 4 Evil eye: +15% Headshot Power
 Tier 4 Mastermind: +200% Tower Capture Speed

 New perks added

 Aim Move Speed Up
 Jump Attack Power Up

 New talents added

 Critical Slash Range UP
 Piloted Weapon Reload Speed Up
 Object Move Up

 New stamps have been added

 Character names can now be changed in the Customize avatar screen

 NVIDIA Image Scaling has been added to the Options screen

 Out-game tutorials can now be redisplayed on each screen

 Core HP percentages are now always displayed on the screen


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png


 The bonus points earned by the winning team will no longer be factored into the player/squad ranking within the result. Instead, they will be accounted for as experience points in the season's result.

 Adjusted the meteors in Ritual Valley A and B, which were stuck on the cliffs and difficult to fall down.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png


 Fixed a bug that caused the Cataclysm Tornado to get caught on minor bumps and stop.
 Fixed a bug where the customization cost of a Legendary weapon was sometimes not accounted for in the total cost.
 Fixed a bug where the idol icon would sometimes be positioned outside the display range on the minimap.
 Fixed a bug where an ally's Barrier would not prevent an enemy's Thundershock.
 Fixed a bug where Orichalcum raked players would momentarily display an aura icon when entering the friend ranking.
 Fixed a bug where the cool time of the last used skill would not advance when joining a team skill.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Players can now zoom-in/out of the mini-map.

 Changed when Deploy Points are earned in Arena Mode.

 Fixed a bug that prevented the kill sound effect from occurring. Also adjusted the kill sound effect.

 Valor points gained for destroying ballistae or cannons increased from 112 to 150.

 On keyboard, some additional keys are now available to have inputs set to them.
 Fixed an issue in Ritual Valley B where mage skill "Shadow Step" could be used to enter the enemy's castle without destroying the gate.
 Other minor bug fixes.

notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

PATCH 1.6.0.1201 is now live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png

New Cleric Skill: Divine Hammer

 This Skill builds up power into the user’s hammer, and then slams it all down in a powerful blow that blasts all surrounding enemies away while also restoring HP to allies.

[previewyoutube=E7ooLnC4n7A;full][/previewyoutube]
Clerics can now Parry!

 Clerics can now Parry by double tapping the shield button. If an enemy hits the Cleric as they Parry, the Cleric will perform a counterattack.

Custom Lobbies for Events

 This feature is intended for use in events and competitions and is not currently open to the public.
 Currently only basic features are implemented with more on the way, including spectator and distribution features.
 Custom Match access can be requested by completing our Event Proposal application https://to.plaion.com/WarlanderCommunityEventProposal Full details and use instructions provided upon approval of the Event Proposal application.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png

Warp Gate
The Cleric Skill Warp Gate can now be destroyed by enemy attacks.

Previously, Warp Gates could only be removed with dispel. By making Warp Gates destructible, there is now more room for counterplay resulting in a greater amount of back-and-forth on the battlefield.

In addition, the duration of the warp gate effect will be extended.

 Lv1 15s → 25s

 Lv2 20s → 30s

 Lv3 25s → 35s

 Lv4 30s → 40s

 Lv5 35s → 45s

[previewyoutube=zG20cYaumNk;full][/previewyoutube]
Rank Points
Adjustments to rank points and rewards earned in 2-army Battles.

 The lower your Rank, the easier it is to earn Rank Points.
 Winning Battles results in earning more Rank Points.

Catapult
Adjusted the catapult on the enemy team side in the 2-army Battle Map Moonlit Temple to prevent it from being destroyed by friendly attacks.

Camera
Fixed an issue where the camera moved in an unintended direction when casting skills, making it difficult to operate.

Settings
Improved so that favorite settings can be changed from the details screen of equipment.

Cover Shot
Cover Shot now aims with the sensitivity as when aiming down sights.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png


 Fixed a bug that caused Ballista bullets to penetrate super guards in rare cases.

 Fixed a bug where training area mode could not be selected after a party broke up.

 Fixed a bug where the Building Accuracy perk was sometimes not reflected.

 Fixed a bug where armor values for robot pilots were not displayed correctly.

 Adjusted critical slash to always point in the target direction.

 Fixed a bug where skill cooldowns are not reset when changing characters.

 Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 🔮 Community Spotlight - JValTV 🔮
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/68d14b6f68d54da58406d79f34c4e68bad6ecb17.jpg

Greetings Warlander!

Part of the latest wave of top-tier humans (he's really an APE) to play Warlander, JVal is much more than just a skilled veteran player. In-grained in the community as a live stream staple and shot-calling leader of the APE Clan, it's hard to believe that JVal hasn't always been here, guiding us in the game and providing a positive, yet extremely honest place to discuss Warlander.

But enough from us, let's let JVal do the talking, it's a fantastic read. ːsteamhappyː  

JValTV Community Spotlight

Who are you?
My handle’s JValTV. I’m from all over the United States and a bit of Canada. I’m a sweaty tryhard that gets hard carried by the sweat team called “APES”. A Warlander only team focused on teamwork and sweaty high-level WL play. Our recruitment post is on the official WL discord. 

How did you come up with your name?
My handles have slowly evolved over the years. I can tell when players met me by what they call me. JValTV started here in Warlander. Had to shorten the full handle to be within the visible character limitations. Johnny comes from my BF4 and Arma III days. While Valentine’s my RL nickname. Why Valentine? Because I was terrible at talking to women. Gamer level bad. My teens and twenties, my attempts to be respectful just came across as awkward. I’d get all anxious, wouldn’t be able to speak, it was a class act disaster. 

How did you find Warlander?
Streamers attract streamers. I was researching new games and came across Maliqu. He was rocking his chainmail setup, making icelance look amazing. If you haven’t seen Maliqu play catch him at https://www.twitch.tv/maliqu. I wouldn’t have found this amazing community without him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/651d67be750f8fe2c0e9eb4260527d903d52d946.png

What kind of content do you make?
I stream for fun and use the footage from streaming to practice video creation. My goal is to be a full-time streamer and to produce X number of videos a week. Lot of time, lot of effort, but the moments when someone pulls a great play (especially against a sweatlord like me) or they learn a “git gud” fact from a video. It feels great. You get a tiny share of a cool experience. 

Where do you make it? 
Twitch
I stream at https://www.twitch.tv/jvaltv. My stream schedule is listed there. Come hang out, feel free to que snipe me (que at the same time I do). I love playing with the community, it keeps the APES and I honest. 

Youtube
My Youtubes: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwx3zCdNUlyimuStDsNgwkA. I do mostly longform content. I may branch into youtube/multi-platform streaming in the future, but for now, it’s a great place to catch Warlander tutorials and sweaty gameplay footage. Those sweat games really show the potential Warlander has. Matches that get your gamer sweat going, that you sign off and think about afterwards and best of all, having that shared experience with your gamer buddies. 

When did you start making content?
I started researching content creation and creating the framework roughly a year ago. I committed and started trial and erroring about 7 to 8 months ago. I started playing Warlander on PC launch day. Have been dedicated to the game ever since. 

What's your process?
For streaming it’s straight forward. Most notable investments being a mic arm and green screen. Mic arm allows you to express yourself a bit more through body language without suffering on audio quality. Green screen is a great investment for cutting out your background and saving that screen space for gameplay. 

For videos, it’s mostly freeware and crutching on youtube tutorials. You can learn just about anything on YT for free. And though taking 3 hours to learn how to create word bubbles in davinci can be an emotional experience... it’s rewarding afterwards to have those tools in your toolkit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Who inspires you? 
I was in the Infantry for seven years. I wouldn’t be a ¼ of the person I am today without the influence from my first squad leader, SGT R. SGT R gave me the tools and behaviors to survive many difficult events and, in the process, learn a lot about myself and life in general. He taught me it’s better to spend every dime you get as a leader investing back into your own team than living on some leadership powertrip. To build the people up around you more than you break them down. That if a leader’s done his job correctly, he’s the most useless person on the crew. A glorified janitor. That the team’s success matters more than you. I owe a lot to that man.

What inspired you to make content?
I did hard and serious work for a long time. Dealing with life and death situations, managing capital in the millions of dollars and all the other laurels of a dangerous vicarial job. From the “thank yous” to the funerals. At some point, I decided I’d prefer a simpler life. I get to play video games and be a team member with fellow players across the entire diversity spectrum. Where nothing else matters about who you are then how well you can work together and take some color’d pixels to the W screen. That is a level of comradery and inclusion hard to find eslewhere without an otherwise steep admission. 

What is the future of your channel and content? 
Starting with season 1, I’ve posted a new stream schedule to better accommodate both the EU and NA viwers. I wish I could crack the language barrier and be more inclusive towards the Asian community. So many great players, great gameplay, and great personalities from that region. Many of which have English translators on their streams, so check them out! While on Youtube, I’m working towards more newbie tutorials and a weekly “best of X season” series. 

What is your special talent?
I’m lucky. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/31f526ad0efd8c4280b4cf6d039bdbd9de407ace.png

What is something that no one knows about you? 
I took a year after service and went nomadic. Lived out of my vehicle. Added extra storage and solar, got rid of lot of my extra house junk and just traveled. Saved up a little nest egg during COVID working some extreme overtime and then spent a few months destination and beach hopping while knocking out some online learning. It was honestly an amazing experience and I often miss it. Wild how much time and energy gets spent to pay for a box that you end up only sleeping in.

What are your goals?
To be a full-time content creator. To be a good person. To provide a product that brings people joy. To sleep soundly at night. To laugh and make others laugh. To make others feel more proud, more confident and to be a fly on the wall for their success. To support as many people as I can who are trying to achieve the same. 

What is your favorite thing you’ve made?
My favorite product earns my channel absolutely nothing. There is no external gain from it. In fact, it’s a net loss for me due to the time expense. But I love my channels twitch clips. When the community has an outplay on the APES and myself and posts us getting clowned on. When you see that solo player rise-up and become a champion of the match and those views spike up. That’s super cool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

What has been your most memorable moment in Warlander?
Elysian, another great WL team, que-sniped my stream one night and that was my first Warlander experience of sweaty team play. There was meta and counter meta, strategic and tactical outplays. And we’d win or lose, palms sweaty and laugh about how much fun it was. That was the moment I knew that I loved this game. That I’d risk my time and effort on its potential because there’s cool stuff under the hood here. Yeah, it needs polish, balancing and creature comforts but the frame of this game, especially for F2P, is wildly good.

What is your favorite Class?
Because I play in a sweaty team environment, we don’t look at class ideology the same. Decks are separated into 5 types. Main Heal, DPS, Utility, Pusher and Hybrid. There’s also a less talked about 6th Deck called “Rank”. Each deck design serves a certain role within the matches/teamplay and may include various classes. My favorite deck is probably Main Heal. I dream about playing Utility Deck. But, I mostly play Main Pusher. 

What does your current deck setup consist of?
I play a “pusher” for the APES. My job is to take ground, contest points and take hits for the rest of the squad. My deck currently has 4 Warriors and 1 Portal Cleric. The detail of the setup depends on the patch version. In general, I use a knock/barrier zero-star warrior, since it’s good all game. Health stacked warriors at various titles, so give my healers more value from their heals and a portal/wall/climb cleric to keep the enemy team honest. 

What advice would you give a new player?
Being new in an established pvp game is difficult. Class, map, and general game mechanic knowledge is extremely powerful stuff. My recommendation is to watch the various WL streamers and ask questions in their chat. Pick their brains. Watch WL videos from active Warlandians. They have a lot of knowledge to share.

Join the Official discord @https://discord.gg/playwarlander. The voice system on that server is amazing, the chats are a great place to get questions answered and find players to group with. Make friends, seriously, little extra teamwork makes the dream work.

Check out the Warlander wiki for any detail-level info you’re looking for. Content creators can’t make videos about this stuff because it outdates too quickly. So, the wiki is great for hyper-specific information.  https://warlander.fandom.com/wiki/Warlander_Wiki. Big shoutout to Hemoura, Gwendoline and crew for their hard work as wiki editors.

What advice would you give to a new Warlander Content Creator?
The streamer to viewership saturation in WL is very favorable for new streamers trying to build their initial audience. The community is incredibly friendly, which gives you a chance to practice your craft and see if content creation is something you enjoy. Because end of the day, it’s still work. Figure out your brand. Find your niche, WL have tons of unfilled content creation niches and just focus on making better content than you made yesterday. And if you do that, the other WL streamers will make the effort to support you. We take care of our own. 

What do you enjoy most about Warlander and what do you look forward to the most in the future?
The Community, hands down. We don’t always agree, especially about balancing or how to lobby for our preferred changes. At the end of the day, there’s a lot of players that love this game. And it’s that love of play that is our great mutual commonality. Good patch, bad patch, bug or tyranny of a meta. I’m always looking forward to that next GG.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: ⚔️ Small Patch - No Version Change ⚔️
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

We've pushed a small patch today to all platforms, details are below:

Feature Improvements
The transition time from one screen to the next as well as the overall time for the War Strategy meeting phase has been shortened.

Parameter Adjustments
Adjustments will be made to Centurion's ULT Skill "Colossus Form".


 Adjusted the duration of Colossus Form from 12s to 15s.

 When Colossus Form is activated, the max HP increase is now increased from 150 to 300.
 
 Attack power increase in increased from 1.2x to 1.3x.
 
 Shortened the recovery time after activating Colossus and Roar.

The goal of the Colossus Ult is to strengthen the Warrior’s role as a tank by temporarily increasing the HP limit and attracting the attention of enemy players. However, in its current state, it was difficult to withstand attacks from multiple enemies, and its ability to survive was poorer than anticipated.

Adjustments to HP for ballistae and cannons.

 600 before reinforcement/1200 after reinforcement → 540 before reinforcement /1080 after reinforcement

This change was made because games were prone to stalemate due to the large impact of anti-siege weapons on the battle situation. In addition, there was little difference in HP between the anti-siege weapons and the defensive parameters, making it difficult to create a choice of which to destroy depending on the situation.

notes.title: ⚔️ Content Update 1.4.1.1166 ⚔️
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!
Content Update 1.4.1.1166 is now available. This update includes a new map and a new practice mode, as well as gameplay improvements, balancing, and bug fixes. 

New Features

New Map
A new map, Moonlit Church has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/7d59fd1004f85bb0ed977c3407768e47f4e92d71.png

Moonlit Church allows players to experience battles under the moonlight and features four catapults in the center which can play an important role in pushing the frontline. Additionally, siege battles utilize two routes requiring new strategies for both defense and attack.

Starting from when the May 2nd update drops until 3:00 pm UTC, 2-Army Battles will be fought exclusively on the Moonlit Temple map.

From May 3rd to May 7th, the Moonlit Temple map will be playable every 30 mins while other maps will rotate in every 60 mins.
 
Specifically, the rotation will occur in 30-minute intervals as follows: 
Dawn Bridge A → Moonlit Temple → Dawn Bridge B → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple

After May 8, the regular schedule will be as follows with maps rotating every 50 minutes:
Dawn Bridge A → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple → Dawn Bridge B → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple

 Map rotation order and schedule are subject to change without notice.
 If matchmaking begins just before a map rotation, there is a possibility that matchmaking will not be successful due to an insufficient number of players, etc.

Practice mode added
This single-player mode allows a player to enter a 2-Army Battle and experience the flow of the game against and alongside BOTs.

Superior Foe Battle
A feature called "Superior Foe Battle" has been added.
Normally, players will be matched with players of the same rank, but if they enter a match where there are more players of a higher rank, the character experience received after the Battle will be increased.

Cataclysm Death Penalty
Characters killed by a Cataclysm will now need to wait longer than normal to respawn.
Players can use this to restrict high level enemy characters by making it more difficult for them to be Deployed in Battle.

Opening Movie added to title screen
After a certain amount of time elapses on the title screen, a movie will play introducing users to the world of Warlander.

Additional Tutorials
An additional tutorial has been added after the tutorial on the flow of Battle explaining Cataclysms and anti-siege weaponry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Feature Improvements

 When the game is first launched, the player now has another set of common equipment for warriors.
 Kill Assist, as well as kills, now earn Valor points according to the Title rank difference of the enemy killed.
 When purchasing equipment from the Shop, the Perk attached to equipment is now displayed in the Shop.
 If a Mage takes damage while summoning a Familiar, the summon will be canceled.
 Familiars can now be summoned in the air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Gameplay Changes

 To alleviate the disparity between players who have just started the game and those who have been playing for a long time and to adjust the overall game tempo, we have lowered the increase in attack power gained through customization.

 Stone Castle Gate 24000→19500

Adjusted the object notation on the tooltip menu to make it easier to identify weapons with high object destruction power.

The warning signs were too short and difficult to react to, so the warning sign motion of the dash slash has been slightly lengthened.

The timing to react to an enemy stagger has been extended.
 The time to launch a critical slash after a stagger was too short, so the time before the stagger ends has been extended.

The Perk for the exclusive Familiar of the Mage Title "Stormbringer" has been changed from increasing servant attack power to strengthening lightning attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where using Squad Markers when boarding some siege weapons would cause the siege weapons to be mistakenly marked.
 Fixed an issue where Characters would sometimes not face the enemy during a critical slash.
 Fixed an issue where falling damage could be avoided by shadow stepping, etc.
 Fixed an issue where a friendly player who was killed by castle destruction could not be resuscitated.
 Fixed a problem in which Valor points could not be earned when dropping an enemy from a cliff with the warrior skill "Smash".
 Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

The release date for the PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of Warlander is set for May 16, 2023! Cross-play will be supported on all platforms.

New content is on the way!
In preparation for the release of the Console Version, new content is rolling out! 

New Maps

notes.title: ⚔️ Content Update 1.4.0.1131 ⚔️
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

Content Update 1.4.0.1131 is live! This update features a new Map, new Mercenary Customization, plus a ton of Feature Improvements, and bug fixes. 

NEW FEATURES

A new map "Dawn Bridge B" has been added!

 This Map is a twist on the existing "Dawn Bridge”.
 The entire Map is now shrouded in fog, and the overall atmosphere has changed dramatically.
 The location and number of towers, walls, and siege and anti-siege weapons have been altered, changing the flow of the battle.
 After this update goes live, the map rotation for 2-army battles will occur every hour and a half. The rotation will be “Ritual Valley” → “Dawn Bridge A” → “Dawn Bridge B.”
 The above rotation will start with the new Dawn Bridge B for 30 minutes from 12:00 to 12:30 (CEST)!
 Update times are subject to change without notice; if the update occurs after 12:30 (CEST), the first "Dawn Bridge B" will be available for play from 15:30 CEST.
 *The map rotation schedule is subject to change without notice.
 *Please note that matchmaking may take time due to an insufficient number of players if started immediately before the map rotates.

Mercenary Customization

 Skills for some Mercenaries are now possible to edit.

Daily Bonus

 A daily bonus feature has been implemented that allows players to earn one more Battle Results reward for the first Battle of the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

FEATURE IMPROVEMENTS
Performance Optimization

 Processing load has been reduced so that the game can be played more comfortably even on low-spec PCs.

Matchmaking

 You can now see the game mode, map, and time elapsed since matchmaking began in the matchmaking lobby. 
 Improved matchmaking algorithm to ensure more equal team making.

Robot

 Previously, it was too easy to defeat Robot pilots. As such, pilots will now receive 10 points of armor per second while riding the Robot (max 200). 
 Made it possible for the Robot driver to open the gate.

Beginner Quests

 Removed beginner quests "Perform a Finisher" and "Play one 5-Army Battle."

Tutorial

 An explanation of Mercenaries is now displayed during the new player tutorial.

Valor

 You can now earn Valor points when destroying weapons with fire damage.

Map Environment Changes

 Certain objects have had their placement adjusted on the map Dawn Bridge.
 Adjusted defensive perimeters around C Tower, E Tower, and the area next to the castle (around the ladders)

Bot Behavior

 Bot behavior has been adjusted so that Bots will behave more in line with the battle situation.

Combat Fixes

 Style (Weapon Swap) Change is no longer canceled when you are struck by a melee attack.
 If an airborne player is struck by a Guard Break they will be blown back as if they were hit by a melee attack. 

Characters

 When deleting a character, you must now reconfirm even after confirming once.

Mouse Invert

 You can now invert the Mouse horizontally and vertically. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS

Warrior and Cleric Melee Fixes and Adjustments

 Changed the speed of some melee attacks used by the Warrior and Cleric for the following reasons:
 Fixed a problem where enemies would appear to not be hit or stunned when attacked by melee attacks.
 Fixed an issue where some attack combos could attack the enemy with no room for counterattack.
 Fixed an issue in which melee attacks could sometimes interrupt opposing melee attacks, thus reducing the importance of the Attack/Guard/Guard Break triangle.

Cleric Melee Damage Vs. Objects Adjustments

 The current damage of the Cleric’s melee damage vs objects is high, so in addition to the above adjustment to the animation speed of melee attacks, the following adjustments have been made:

Cleric melee attack damage to objects adjustments

 Normal 1…45→22
 Normal 2…45→22
 Normal 3…120→60
 Critical Strike…50→37
 Guard Break 1…15→7
 Guard Break 2…22→11
 Guard Break 3…30→15
 Jump Attack…67→33
 Jump Attack（From High）…120→60
 Dash Attack…67→33
 Back Attack…90→45

Power Bomb

 For the Warrior skill "Power Bomb", the timing between the activation of the skill and the beginning of the Super Armor has been delayed slightly in order to add more counterplay to interactions involving this Skill.

Siege and Anti-Siege

 To adjust the impact of catapults in Battle, damage taken by wooden objects set ablaze by the catapult has been reduced from 600 to 300. 
 Siege weapons now take 10 damage per second when on fire, down from 30 per second.
 Anti-siege weapon base durability has been increased from 120 to 400 as Mages were destroying them too easily.
 Changed the HP of cannons before/after reinforcement from 400/800 to 300/600, the same value as a ballista. Reload time adjusted from 3s to 2s

Centurion Balance

 The movement speed of the Legendary Warrior Title "Centurion" in Colossus Form has been reduced to 136% speed, down from 200%. This is due to the Skill potentially affecting gameplay in a network game.

Cataclysm

 The position of Cataclysm Idols for each map has been adjusted so that it appears more in line with the battle situation.

Valor Points Earning Adjustments
Valor Point acquisition has been adjusted in the following ways, in order to better maintain fairness in battle:

Kills

 The difference in Title Ranks is now factored into the number of Valor Points earned when a kill is made.

Squad Missions

The following adjustments have been made because the large number of Valor points earned from Squad missions was causing immediate Valor Level increases, leading to one-sided Battles.

 Valor Points earned for each squad mission 400/800/1200 -> 200/400/800

Adjustments have been made to the squad missions, as there was a large difference in the difficulty level between the different squad roles.

Assault Squad

 Destroy 50% or more of an enemy Core → Destroy 10% or more of an enemy Core

Castle Guard Squad

 0 Damage to your Core for 3 mins/6 mins/10 mins → 0 Damage to your Core for 5 mins/8 mins/12 mins

Special Ops Squad (Dawn Bridge A, The Pentagon)

 Dawn Bridge A: Capture 4 or more towers at the same time → Capture 5 or more towers at the same time
 The Pentagon: Capture 5 or more towers at the same time → Capture 6 or more towers at the same time

If a Battle is settled before the requirements of a Squad Mission are met, Valor Points will be awarded as soon as the Battle ends.

Valor Rank

 Along with the adjustment of Valor Points earned for kills, the Valor points required to advance to each Valor rank have also been adjusted.
 Valor Points required to advance to each Valor Level
 500/1200/2100/3200/4500 → 500/1300/2400/3800/5500


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

BUG FIXES

 Fixed a bug that caused team-making to fail in rare cases, resulting in a network error.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes allowed two players to acquire a Cataclysm at the same time.
 Fixed an issue where the Robot self-destructs attack damage would not destroy Siege Weapons.
 Fixed an issue where the "Firewall" skill would not hit an enemy who was guarding.
 Fixed an issue where colliding with a shield while using the skill Rushdown would not detonate a Wind mine.
 When attempting to set a squad marker while riding a siege weapon, the marker will now be placed correctly at the crosshair. 
 Fixed a bug that prevented Crystal Defender from responding to users on Ballistae.
 Fixed a problem where Lightning Shock would not hit enemies on ballistae.
 Camera option settings are now applied when operating the Robot's gunner seat.
 Fixed issue where resuscitate wouldn’t work sometimes on inclines.
 Fixed a bug where quests for earning Valor Points, which are exclusive to each class, could be earned by other classes.
 Fixed a bug where a dash slash or guard break would rarely display the prompt for a Critical Strike.
 Fixed an issue where Mercenaries were not customized appropriately compared to their CP count.
 Fixed a bug where guard behavior may be incorrect for the following Skills and Familiars:
 Crystal Defender
 Wind Trap 
 Magic Napalm
 Anti-Siege Weapon: Cannon
 Rocket Punch
 Rocket
 Other minor bug fixes


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Thank you for your continued love and support!
⚔️ Your Warlander Team 🛡️

notes.title: 🔮 Warlander Community Spotlight Hangry_Henry 🔮
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/c4dd74a1c7e3cd724de8cfd60ea6afd55b5f671e.png

Greetings Warlander!

To celebrate Warlander’s recent PC release and the phenomenal community that helped get us here, we are kicking off the debut of our Community Spotlight series where we recognize standout community members who have become true ambassadors of Warlander in and outside of the game. 

What better way to launch this spotlight series, than with one of our OG Content Partners that has not only been holding it down since Open Beta but has in a very short time amassed a viewership that has everyone taking notice.

Looking for top-tier supportive content with a touch of razzle-dazzle and love? Hangy Henry is your guy! 

Hangry Henry Community Spotlight

Hangry Henry the Entertainer

How did you come up with the name Hangry Henry? 
When I don’t eat, I become Hangry Henry. It’s real, you can see it live. If I don’t eat, I get Hangry. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/2190efa362597fb8686eb207d6aa0c1ddf97fd5f.jpg

When did you start making content?
October 2022

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/a6d438d20d96a0fed7d4fea2ebb37273a8fdf88f.jpg

What inspired you to make content? 
I spent time building a career in a field that made me unhappy. I decided to stop and do something that I love.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/e0bac4a40d2bb675eae0a141e981d358d1af1374.jpg

What are your goals as a content creator? 
To have as much fun as possible and to have as many people play Warlander as possible- it’s really fun to play with friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/85a34de6bfaf7f06fef3779cca633aadf2216604.jpg

Where can we find your content? 
https://www.twitch.tv/hangry_henry LIVE from my home in Washington (USA)
https://www.youtube.com/@hangry_henryttv7727

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Hangry Henry the Warlander

How did you find Warlander? 
My brother asked me what games I was playing over dinner. I said, “Escape from Tarkov and other things.” He told me to check out Warlander, “I shit you not, one of the spells is finger guns.” I said, “I’ll have to try that.” The rest is history. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/e44ca0c3a3da65286b0ae0fc7d8c1f1f1c8b95b4.png

Why should people watch you make Warlander content? 
You’ll learn techniques for the game and find the best community in our chat 

What is your favorite piece of Warlander content that you’ve created? 
My Execute Order 66 video
https://youtu.be/etDuqDk7WE4

What advice would you give to a new Warlander Content Creator? 
Be yourself and be happy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Hangry Henry in the Warland

What has been your most memorable moment in Warlander?
Toss up between Being called a Gigachad by Sacriel and being the world’s first Centurian.

What is your favorite Class in Warlander? 
Warrior, because as long as I have my team as support I cannot die. 

What does your current deck setup consist of? 
0-Star build-speed Cleric | 1-star Warrior The Peacock | 3-Star Mage Darth Tickle | 5-Star Warrior Henturion | 5-Star Warrior Henturion 2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/7980bfb3d33121dc34f2baef61bdd716beac1597.png

What advice would you give a new player? 
Start with 0-Star of each class first, play around with the class and find which one you like. From there, decide which you want to grind to 5-Star.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Hangry Henry IRL

Who inspires you? 
Benjamin Franklin, the dude said, “write something worth reading, or do something worth writing about.” I try to do that every day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/b8eb8ebc01e8d065e02dae213f49619ee9ddaa60.jpg

What is your special talent? 
I can whistle through my nose. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/473987d7fff6c7c3432089f0cd0330eae1192f58.jpg

What is something that no one knows about you? 
I have a five-octave vocal range, like Beyoncé mutha *****. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

The future of Hangry Henry

What do you enjoy most about Warlander and what do you look forward to the most in the future?
I love all of the cosmetic and otherwise customizations. It’s so fun to change things up to Min Max the game. I look forward to new subclasses in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/91340eac36a217effccbbc6ccd00d542c3885034.png

What is the future of your channel and content? 
Sky is the limit - come be a part of it.

Change of season duration

 The end date of the current Season 0 has been changed.
 Before change: Ends April 19, 2023, at 9:00 (UTC)
 Now: April 25, 2023, 9:00 (UTC)

Additional Functions

 Event rules have been added that only certain classes can participate.
 Elemental Fury will be held under this rule, in which only Mages can participate.
 We hope you will enjoy a different kind of long-distance warfare-oriented Warlander!

Leaver Penalties

 Penalties will now be given for exiting from the menu or leaving a game unattended.
 Players who do not finish a match properly will not be able to enter the match for a certain period of time.
 Players who are repeatedly doing things that are subject to penalties will have their penalties extended and will be restricted from matching for a longer period of time.
 We will continue to add new ways of detecting game abandonment (AFK) to penalize.

Voice Macros

 Voice macros will no longer be notified to other players if used multiple times in a row.
 When using voice macros or markers in succession, callouts and voice macros will no longer play continuously on other players' screens.

Beginner Quests
Improved the content of beginner quests.

 Changed the conditions for clearing steps 1-4.
 If there is a quest with changed conditions for a step that is currently in progress, the progress with the old conditions will be reset.
 If there is a Quest with changed conditions in an already-cleared step, it will remain clear.
 This change does not revert the cleared step to an uncleared state.

Keybindings
The following key configurations can now be changed:

 Entering additional skills
 Cancel a Skill
 Re-Deploy

UI/UX Improvements

 New item and title icons now disappear when the cursor is held over them.
 Tooltips for Familiars now display attack power against humans and objects.
 Changed so that Glamours already installed are also displayed in the list of equipment appearance changes.
 The range of emotes that can be set for each voice macro has been increased.

Adjustments to Training Area

 BOTs with higher title ranks have been placed in the training area.
 Allied BOTs in the training area now participate in team skills.
 The behavior of BOTs in the training area when blown away while in guard status has been changed.
 Before: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position by normal movement.
 After change: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position while guarding.

Gameplay adjustments
Opening Gates

 When an enemy player is near and outside the gate, the gate cannot be opened.
 The judgment of opening and closing the gate according to the position of the enemy and the player attempting to open the gate will be as follows.

The gate can be opened.

 Opener: Inside the gate -- Enemy: Inside the gate
 Opener: Outside of the gate -- Enemy: Inside of the gate

Cannot open the gate

 Opener: Inside the gate -- Enemy: Near and outside the gate
 Opener: Outside of the gate -- Enemy: Near and outside of the gate

Tower Capture 

 You can now earn Valor points even when you reduce the control meter of an enemy Tower.
 The number of Valor points earned when capturing a Tower has been adjusted from 50 to 40 points.
 The behavior of BOTs during a match has been improved.
 Enemy players in your castle will always be shown on the map.

Skill Balance
Thunderstorm

 Stormbringer's ULT "Thunderstorm" now grants 200 armor to the caster.

Dispel

 When using Dispel on Firewall, it is now possible to erase the entire firewall.

Fog

 Fog has been adjusted from 15s to 18s because of its short cool time and wide range, which had a greater impact on the battlefield than expected.
 Cool time: 15s to 18s
 The range of the effect has been reduced at all levels.

Crystal Defender
The following adjustments have been made to the Crystal Defender, which had a short cool time, making it easier to activate multiple times in a single battle.
Cooldown: 6s to 18s

Healing
The following adjustments have been made to the Valor Points earned when healing an allied player, as it was an easier way to earn Valor Points than to use other actions.
The amount of Valor points earned has been decreased from 60 to 50.

Team Play
In order to evaluate actions that contribute to the team from various perspectives, the following evaluation items have been added:

 When a player grants Holy Armor to a teammate, he or she receives Valor points.
 However, players do not earn Valor points when they grant Holy Armor to themselves or before the start of a match.
 Dispelling an enemy's object born from a Skill or Protection on an enemy will earn you Valor points.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the tooltip of guard shooting sometimes did not show the attack power.
 Fixed a bug where the breakdown of Valor points of mercenaries was not displayed in the results.
 Fixed a bug that caused the season rank progress gauge to show unnatural behavior under certain conditions in results.
 Fixed a problem in which the required CP value displayed in the tooltip in results was displayed as lvl 1 regardless of the actual level.
 Fixed a problem in which alliance status was not synchronized across players in rare cases.
 Fixed a problem in which players' Valor points in a match were sometimes not synchronized properly.
 Fixed a problem in which Valor points for capturing a Tower could be earned repeatedly under certain conditions.
 Fixed a bug in which the key help message "Close the gate" would sometimes appear when the winch was deactivated.
 Fixed a bug where the display of the anti-object attack power of Powerbomb was displayed.
 Fixed a bug where the beginner quest would not be cleared even if an emote was performed during the victory or defeat staging.
 Fixed a problem in which it appeared that the maximum number of skills and talents could be obtained in the result rewards.
 Fixed an issue where a long wait time would sometimes occur when purchasing items in the store in succession.
 Fixed a problem in which some reward images were not displayed on the Season Pass screen.
 Fixed an issue that could cause members of an army to be separated from party members after being matched together.
 Fixed an issue where the robot would sometimes stay floating when it landed.
 Fixed a problem in which the HP of the player on the robot was sometimes displayed incorrectly when the player was on the robot.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the camera to behave incorrectly when a player lost a match while falling.
 Fixed a problem in which some traces of Sentry Anti Cheat remained after uninstalling Warlander. While these files were not functional and totally harmless, the un-clean uninstall was not intended and was also misleading. 
 Fixed a problem in which the player could be attacked by the Crystal Defender even if he or she guarded against it.
 Some text has been corrected.
 Fixed some sound effects.

We were able to identify and fix many bugs through reports and communications from our players.
Thank you for your cooperation in improving the game.

And of course, thank you for your continued support of Warlander.

Matchmaking
Matchmaking Adjustments
An update to the matchmaking system has been implemented to make it easier to be matched with players of similar ranks, taking into account the current player population.

Gameplay Changes
After analyzing the data obtained so far, it was found that the tempo of game progression was a little slower than expected.

Also, since it was more difficult than expected to break into the castle by using ladders, the following adjustments will be made while taking into consideration the balance with other siege weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/732ba54e2f272758ddae8c2207e14161cda1abf8.png Castle door durability: decreased from 1500 to 800.

Item Adjustments
Glamour Rarity
Equipment can now have any compatible Glamour applied to it regardless of rarity. 

The previous restriction was intended to allow players to judge the strength of equipment to some extent by its appearance.

However, we have removed this restriction so that players can enjoy customizing their equipment more freely.

Shop Adjustments
Mercenary Contracts
The prices of Mercenary Contracts have been lowered so that players who have just started the game can purchase them.

notes.title: 🌟 Warlander - Prepare for release! 🌟
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

The time has come!
The time has finally come for the world to Sing Together in the Warland! 

Next Tuesday the 24th of January at 17:00 (5 PM) CET, Warlander releases officially on Steam.    
To those of you that have been battling bugs and fortifying features over the last few months, we salute you. Warlander would not be where it is today without your patience, loyalty, and undying support.

Built to the core as a multiplayer game Warlander will feature up to 100 players in a single battle and will be released to a global audience. For us to achieve victory it’s crucial that we continue our community-focused development with a transparent look at the Warlander PC release, so that we are all properly prepared to help make Warlander not only a success but also a contender for the top of the leaderboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

A Call to War!
To help the Warlander PC release be as successful as possible, we ask YOU, our dedicated community for your continued support. The best way to help Warlander in the next days and weeks is to play Warlander, as well as continue to provide us with your fantastic feedback. 

On top of that, our visibility on Steam relies on an algorithm that you can help boost by wishlisting and following Warlander, writing a review about your experience with the game and your time within our community, and by reaching out to us directly when there is something frustrating you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Welcome to Warlander!
On behalf of Toylogic and PLAION, we welcome all sword slashers, siege smashers, and castle crashers to join us from day one to set the tone for our fledgling player base to grow and prosper over the weeks, months, and years to come. 

Before we get ahead of ourselves and look too far into the future, we must take a look at the upcoming release and clarify what to expect as an early player of Warlander. 
Please keep in mind the following four factors as matchmaking kicks in officially for the first time and we start the process of welcoming new players into the Warland. With the global release, Warlander will be home to players from all over the world, and we understand the necessity to match regionally for the best possible ping, but also that queue time, skill/experience-based matching, and playing with a full match of players are all important aspects of your expectations as a player. 

As the first servers are created, please be patient with the process, as you may initially have similar matchmaking results to the Closed Beta, meaning that there may be times when you are matched with players from other regions, have a higher queue time, are matched with players of a higher or lower skill and experience level, and/or have matches with bots, especially at non-peak hours. This is expected and we ask that you make the best of it as we fine-tune the matchmaking to offer the best results moving forward. 
  
As the player base grows the fine-tuning process will begin where we will tweak the settings to best support having full, regional, skill-based matches, and ideally with a reasonable queue time. From there we will look at popular regions and based on player numbers, continue to roll out further regional support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Squad up with us!
Community is not a buzzword for us, it is our passion and the driving force to make Warlander the best possible game it can be, so if you haven’t already joined us in Discord or followed our other channels, now is the time. 

❤️ Discord
💙 Twitch
💜 Twitter
💛 Twitter Japan
💚 TikTok

And finally, while Warlander can be fun solo queuing, it can also be played in parties of four players and there is really nothing more satisfying than playing with a full party where the heals, shields and damage are all working in a finely tuned and coordinated rhythm. So rally your friends, build alliances and we’ll see you in the Warland, as we Sing Together and charge to war!

Sincere thanks for your continued love and support. It means the world to us. 

⚔️ Your Warlander Team 🛡️

Join our community-focused game development discussions on your favorite platform:
❤️ Steam Discussions
💙 Discord
💜 Twitch
💛 Twitter

notes.title: Warlander - End of Open Beta & Release Information
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

We are very happy to finally share the details that you have all been waiting for, in this Warlander news update. 

Over the past couple of months, you have provided valuable support and feedback throughout the Open Beta and have shown impressive patience while waiting for news, so to honor that, rather than share a wall of sentiment of how appreciative we are, we will get right into the details. Our appreciation is shared in detail at the end. ːsteamthumbsupː
    
END OF OPEN BETA
The Open Beta will come to an end this Friday, November 18 (5PM JST / 9AM CET). We wanted to give you guys a chance to play a few more rounds before we close the Beta, and for those of you that haven’t played 25 games yet, this is your opportunity to get in and secure your Open Beta rewards. We will be hosting a Happy Hour on Thursday Evening (CET), where we will be jumping in with you guys for some final slashes and bashes. Stay tuned to Discord Events for details. 

As a reminder, Open Beta progress will be wiped.

CONTINUED PLAY – CLOSED BETA
We had originally planned to not have any down-time after the Open Beta, but that will unfortunately not be the case. 

For those of you (like us 😊) that cannot wait for the PC Release to play again, we’re working on setting up a Closed Beta for mid December to collect feedback, suggestions, and bug reports on the PC Release build. Stay tuned for participation details.

EARLY ACCESS
We have decided to drop the Early Access phase and go directly into the official PC Release. The reason for this is that we chose to dedicate the time and effort that it would take to set up the Early Access version of Warlander and put that time and effort into the release. Not much changes with this, as you will still have the opportunity to test and provide feedback on monetization and other core features at release.  

PC RELEASE
Warlander will release on PC on the 24th of January 2023. The reason for the push into January is that essentially, you guys were too good at your job. 😊 Meaning, we received so much fantastic feedback, suggestions, and bug reports around topics that we want to consider for release, that we had to take a step back and reevaluate the timing. We’re very excited to be at the home stretch and can’t wait to officially release Warlander to the world.   

CONSOLE RELEASE
Our Gen 9 Console (PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S) Release is now officially planned for April.  

OPEN BETA REWARDS RECAP
As a reminder, we have finalized our Open Beta rewards. With the end of the Open Beta this Friday, make sure you get your games in so you don’t miss out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941782/a00f417f3314b3858729f8e8d82871b26952fb88.png

The Warlander Bundle: 
Play at least 10 Open Beta (Steam Playtest) matches (combination of 2 and 5 Army Battles)
- Aura crystals x 10
- Experience Boost x1
- Rewards Boost x1
- Rarity Boost x1
- Emblem "Crown" (This is exclusive to the Open Beta and will not be offered after the Open Beta ends)

The Warlord Bundle:
Play 25 or more Open Beta (Steam Playtest) matches (combination of 2 and 5 Army Battles)
- Aura Crystals x10
- Experience Boost x1
- Rewards Boost x1
- Rarity Boost x1
- Emblem "Crown" (This is exclusive to the Open Beta and will not be offered after the Open Beta ends)
- Glamour Blueprint "Valor Sword (Gold)" + (Equipment: Mythic Sword)

The Open Beta Reward Bundles will be granted shortly after the start of the PC Release to all players that have fulfilled the requirements.

The Experience Booster increases the experience you gain after the match ends and does not affect in-game Valor earnings.

Please let us know if you have questions about any of this.

Again, we can’t emphasize how great you have all been so far. Sincere thanks from all of us for your continued feedback, suggestions, and support, as well as your community-created content and entertaining livestreams. We really wouldn’t be where we are without our community and we thank you all for that. As previously mentioned, your efforts have already helped improve Warlander and we’re very excited to share the release version with you, which will include improvements and content based on the shared sentiment and collective ideas of you, our Open Beta community. 

Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

⚔️  Your Warlander Team 🛡️

notes.title: Warlander Open Beta Rewards
notes.content:
Greetings Warlander!

Thank you for your continued patience as we finalize the end date of the Open Beta and the start date of Early Access. 

We appreciate your support so far while providing feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. Your efforts have already helped improve Warlander and we’re currently working on some very important topics which have come directly from your shared sentiment and collective ideas. 

To reiterate the latest Early Access news: 
We want to present you with an Early Access version that will not only meet our own quality standards but also address as many of the problems and improvement opportunities as possible that you helped us identify during Open Beta testing.
 
Bringing Warlander to this state will ensure that we can confidently begin to market Warlander and bring in new players. We want to make sure that as much of your feedback around the new player experience as possible is worked in so that we can positively build on the excellent community that has helped us get to here.
 
Taking our time at this point to get things right will benefit all of us in the long run.

In the meantime, we have been working on creating the Open Beta Rewards bundles, and we are very excited to finally share those with you today.

The Warlander Bundle:
Play at least 10 Open Beta (Steam Playtest) matches (combination of 2 and 5 Army Battles)
- Aura crystals x 10
- Experience Boost x1
- Rewards Boost x1
- Rarity Boost x1
- Emblem "Crown" (This is exclusive to the Open Beta and will not be offered after the Open Beta ends)

The Warlord Bundle:
Play 25 or more Open Beta (Steam Playtest) matches (combination of 2 and 5 Army Battles)
- Aura Crystals x10
- Experience Boost x1
- Rewards Boost x1
- Rarity Boost x1
- Emblem "Crown" (This is exclusive to the Open Beta and will not be offered after the Open Beta ends)
- Glamour Blueprint "Valor Sword (Gold)" + (Equipment: Mythic Sword)

The Open Beta Reward Bundles will be granted shortly after the start of Early Access to all players that have fulfilled the requirements.

The Experience Booster increases the experience you gain after the match ends and does not affect in-game Valor earnings.

As a reminder, Early Access player data will not be wiped.

We know you are looking forward to Early Access and permanent progression in Warlander, and we will be sharing that information with you next. In the meantime let us know if you have any questions about the rewards and tell us what you are looking forward to the most in Early Access! 

Thanks for your continued feedback and support! 

Your Warlander Team

notes.title: Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.6.626
notes.content:
Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.6.626

Greetings Warlander!
Our next balance and improvement patch is now available! 
This includes improvements to matchmaking, as well as various bug fixes based on your collective feedback. 
 
Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

Matchmaking System
We have implemented a system that divides players into armies based on each player's past performance. 

 Teams will be divided based on the winning percentage of the past 10 rounds.
 This is meant to help addresses team composition.

5-army battles now open once every 19 minutes instead of being always open.

 After 19 minutes have elapsed, the mode is opened for 1 minute.
 The layout of the Game Mode selection has been adjusted accordingly.
 The time until 5-army battles open matchmaking is indicated on the Play button and on the game mode selection button, when a 5 Army Battle is selected as the game mode.

Character Actions

 Fixed Sprint being interrupted by some voice macros or setting markers.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with Lunge Slash passing through walls.
 Fixed an issue where the travel distance for Lunge Slash Lv5 was shorter than Lv4. 
 Fixed an issue where the amount of damage from Magic Napalm was different than indicated. 
 Fixed an issue where skill EXP values were displayed incorrectly when skills were acquired on the results screen. 
 Fixed an issue where the animation of power bombs was impacted by lag. 
 Changed call timing of game start API. Server load reduction support has been implemented. 
 Fixed a bug that caused parties to break up on rare occasions.

Thanks for your continued feedback and support! 

⚔️  Your Warlander Team  🛡️

notes.title: Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.5.580
notes.content:
Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.5.580

Greetings Warlander!
Our next balance and improvement patch is now available! 
This includes balance adjustments, as well as some improvements based on your feedback, including adding a Report Player button to the Support screen, adding an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake, adding server selection to the options menu (players may now select the server they wish to prioritize for matchmaking - Please keep in mind that this may affect queue times), and title acquisition cutscenes can now be skipped.
 
Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

Improvements to the 2-Army Battle Map
Previously the catapult area and the central area were connected, easily allowing an army that captured the central area to also capture the catapult shortly afterward, making it difficult for opposing armies to mount a comeback.

Therefore, based on community feedback, as well as data obtained from the OBT, we have now separated the central area and the catapult area topographically and added new towers to the catapult routes.

We believe that this clarifies the role of each route and changes how each route influences the overall battle. Please give the map changes a try and let us know what you think. 

Game Rules

 Added a new mechanic that determines the spawn point of the Cataclysmic Idol based on the battle situation and player locations. 
 In order to increase the number of Valor Points earned by Catapult operators, we have increased the amount of Valor Points gained when destroying Ballistas and Cannons.
 New objectives for each Squad Role
 Assault Squads: Damage an enemy Core (more Valor Points received than Spec Ops Squads and Castle Guard that do the same)
 Spec Ops Squads: Damage an enemy Core/defeat enemies near the catapult/defeat enemies around your Castle
 Castle Guard Squads: Defeat enemies around the castle (more Valor Points received than Assault and Spec Ops Squads that do the same)
 Adjusted the number of Valor Points earned from 800 to 1000 for each unit mission completed by Special Ops Squads.
 Added a feature that allows a player to instantly Redeploy after a certain amount of time has passed from their death.
 Fixed an issue in 2-Army Battles where players could earn more Valor points than usual by destroying and rebuilding the ladder attached to the wooden fort on the stone bridge.


Robot

 Sped up melee attack slightly
 Machine gun damage increased from 20 to 30
 Cannon damage increased from 60 to 100


Hymn of War

 Shortened casting time.


UI/HUD

 Improved HUD for Core HP display at the top center of the screen.
 Added an animation for when the Core is struck by an attack.
 Added a button on the support screen that leads to the Report Player page.
 Added an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake.
 Added server selection to the options menu.
 Users may select the server they wish to prioritize for matchmaking.
 Title acquisition cutscenes can now be skipped.
 Added description of Servant effects in the Servant tutorial.
 Added tutorial for Perk levels for Perks attached to equipment
 Rerolled Perks are now guaranteed to be different from the Perk that was rerolled.
 Added Emote sample playback function on the Emote menu screen.
 Number and price of aura crystals available for purchase have been adjusted.
 Changed standard price setting from 500 Silvings to 1000 Silvings
 Reversed camera controls selected in options are disregarded when using the mouse.
 Other minor UI/HUD improvements.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused a Character's style to be the same as the previously deployed character's when redeploying.
 Fixed a bug where the English skill descriptions for Lunge Slash and Magic Napalm were different from their actual effects.
 Fixed a bug in which key configuration changes were not reflected in the voting HUD, basic control HUD, or key prompts.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from boarding a siege-weapon when they were disconnected from the network.
 Fixed a rare issue where siege-weapons destroyed while on fire could no longer be built.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented users from clicking the EULA approval button.
 Improved stability of full-screen mode behavior on monitors of sizes other than 16:9.


Thanks for your continued feedback and support! 

⚔️  Your Warlander Team  🛡️
